note: The contract's vocabulary and its values, one file (#630, #634, freeform #629). `tokens`: every token's name, its default value and the axiom or rule it serves; a name is the contract's and ours, a value is a pick and the person's, but for the three marked `fixed` (error, write, live: the meaning channel), whose values no person's AI re-maps. `palette`: the preset values the names are laid from (the functional colours, the gradients, the creature, the scale, the material, the motion), once sol/design/palette.json. tokens.mjs, run by the face's build, writes both from here: sol/mac/src/palette.css and creature/palette.ts from `palette`, sol/mac/src/tokens.css from `tokens`; never written by hand. `contract` is the one number: /health says it, every record is stamped with it. `places` are where a block may render. `migrations` holds one entry per contract bump, { from, to, keys: { old: new } }, a key renamed or, set to null, retired; a step without its entry fails tokens.mjs, and the engine runs them over a person's blocks at the first start after a release (engine/src/release.ts).

palette.note: Sol's colours, one file. FIRST PASS (2026-10-18), awaiting the references: every value is picked from the creature's own pixels (icon-grid.json) except red soft, mixed from ember. The references swap in here; run palette-build.py, no code changes. Functional colours are fixed signals for the states; the seat gradients colour everything at rest, as before step 3 (repair 2026-10-18: only the chat box's highlight goes plain); the creature's ten colours are named for the things that wear one.

green.note: done, good. Strong: the done flash, a tick that lands. Soft: a quiet it-went-fine. From the creature: mint, green.

yellow.note: waiting on you (Your call). Strong: the pulse when the ask arrives. Soft: the ask at rest. From the creature: butter, sun.

red.note: wrong, unplugged. Strong: the wrong flash, a failure. Soft: Unplugged, steady. Strong is the creature's ember; soft is ember mixed toward white (not a creature pixel).

sol.note: the creature's own candy to sun (the old ring's sol slice). Working: the one moving colour.

home.note: the home (life) seat, candy to heart: its glow, dots, switch fragment and wipe, pings, Show stripe, and the creature's dust and corner tint at rest.

work.note: the work seat, sun to orange: the same places as home.

dawn.note: warm and soft: the creature's pastels blush, peach, butter. Decorative, for cosmetics.

meadow.note: cool: the creature's greens mint, leaf, green, lime. Decorative, for cosmetics.

creature.note: the creature's ten colours in its own order, named. Decorative, for things that wear one colour: the hands, the Show's lanes, the landing shimmer, a step running.

ink.note: text, and the one plain highlight: the chat box's fringe (face.css --ink).

scale.note: every space, type size, control height and corner the face may use (the layout skill, .claude/skills/layout). The gate's lint refuses any other number in the face's css. Added 2026-11-08 for the stage's block frame (v4 §4, #738): type head 12.5/16, a block's title in its 34px head (the pick "head 34px"); type big 19/26, a card's one sentence; height head 34, the block's head. Added 2026-11-09 (ui.md "Type", #761): display 28/34, Home's one line, one per screen; code 12/20 in the mono family (tokens.mono), diff, terminal, values. Retired: t-pill 11.5, into label.

material.note: the look's values beside the scale (the design root's one material system, sol/design/root.md): every colour, sheen and shadow the rebuilt face may use, moved as they were from the clean Home (2026-11-02, #597), no new look. palette.css gets --c-<name>, --sheen-<name> and --shadow-<name>. The gate's lint refuses any other colour or shadow in the rebuilt face.

shade.note: the one black in its shade steps (brand.md, the material; the kit, #674): every surface is the black at one of these opacities over the window, which is the black at `window` over the desk, blurred by `blur`. The contract's base-alpha, base-blur, side, surface (card), raised, island (box) and pop carry these numbers, and tokens.mjs fails when one drifts. `on` is the on colour's strengths: words ink, dim and mute, a line, an edge, the hover's wash. `read`, behind the run's switches (stage.whole, sol.home.whole; #891, the seven human checks): a window that carries words is near solid (`window`), so the desktop never reads through; words are never under 4.5:1, so the two quiet strengths rise to `dim` and `mute` (0.32 is 2.7:1 even on pure black: mute stays for ticks and glyphs at rest, not words); a block is drawn on the `block` step, solid, so one never shows through another. palette.css --read-window, --read-dim, --read-mute; the kit, SHADE.read. `drag`, the blur of a block while dragged (ui.md blur-drag, #761: nothing nested blurs, frozen never blurs), palette.css --blur-drag. palette.css gets --shade-<step>; the kit, sol/mac/src/kit/tokens.ts.

glass.note: the glass and the jelly's light on it (Body.tsx's shader: the key light from the upper left, the white it mixes in at the rim, the specular). `surfaces`: what a piece of glass carries of that light; glass, the shade alone with an even hairline, is every surface's default (the product lead's pick, kit round 1, a); raised (the key light on the rim) and box (the rim and an inner sheen) are named, for things you touch.

jelly.note: the jelly's colours, the accent source (brand.md, the jelly; Body.tsx): the six of the creature's colours, named from `creature.colours`, in the sketch's order, and how they lie as one gradient, the way the effort pill lays its heat: bands at `angle`, soft-edged by `soft`, `veil` the dark that holds a word over them. `warm` is the four a liquid rises through. Whatever lights in the kit lights in these, never one colour of its own and never from creature/goo.tsx. palette.css gets --jelly, the bands.

curve.note: the continuous corner, macOS 26's (brand.md, the material): curvature that grows from zero, drawn as a path (sol/mac/src/kit/curve.ts, Apple's squircle at `smoothing`), never border-radius. The kit's corners; the card's is looks.card's pick. scale.radius is the face's border-radius today; each part moves to these as it is rebuilt on the kit. palette.css gets --curve-<name>.
curve.why: block 18: a stage block's frame (v4 §4 rule 11, #738; looks.card's take b, between); mark 5: a block kind's 16px mark in its head; box 20: the box in hand (ui.md c-box, #761)

glyph.note: the acts' and the kinds' glyphs (ui.md Components, ui.html (f), #764): drawn once on a `grid` of 20 with round ends, set in a `size` box of 24 (the drawing at its own size, centred), the stroke `stroke` px at any size. Colour is the on colour: mute at rest, dim on hover (shade.on). The paths: sol/mac/src/kit/Glyph.tsx; the kit, sol/mac/src/kit/tokens.ts GLYPH.
